title: 2025: the remaining Millennium Problems reduce to one continuity law

statements.text: The Yang-Mills mass gap, the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture, the Hodge conjecture, P versus NP and geometrization can each be expressed through the same conserved temporal current, regulated norm constraint and temporal inertia tensor.

standing.reason: The author graded this claim superseded in his July 2026 Version 2.0 rebuild. No test has decided it.

sources.quote: The present work reformulates the Yang–Mills mass gap, the Birch and Swinnerton–Dyer conjecture, the Hodge conjecture, the P versus NP problem, and geometrization within a single conserved temporal transport field defined on a four-dimensional spacetime manifold.
